6 parts, each with its own write-up

  • Tracked site

    A demo site that stores a click ID only after consent and carries it through the form into the CRM.

    In progress
  • Salesforce routing and conversions

    Leads from the form get a stage, a campaign and an owner in Salesforce. Conversions go back to Google Ads.

    In progress
  • Campaign QA agent

    A Python tool that checks landing pages for tags, consent, the conversion event and UTM values before launch.

    Planned
  • Lead qualifier agent

    Claude scores each new lead against a written rubric, routes the strong ones and asks a person when unsure.

    Planned
  • Funnel in SQL and a reporting agent

    The funnel and ad credit in SQL, and a weekly summary where code checks every number before it is published.

    Planned
  • CRM cleanup

    Duplicate accounts and contacts in Salesforce found and merged by script, with every merge graded.

    Planned

Upgrow marketing operations platform

The internal platform I built for the paid media team at work. One warehouse pulls the ad, tag, task, meeting and CRM data. Workflows on top handle monthly reports, budget pacing, tracking audits and morning alerts. It never changes an account on its own.
